Football Italia Live Blog
Join us for all the build-up, in-game commentary and post-match reactions as they happen for Tuesday’s three Serie A matches: Sassuolo vs. Lazio, Roma vs. Cagliari and Torino vs. Como.
We begin at 17.30 GMT (18.30 CET) with Sassuolo against Lazio, who sit level with Inter at the top of the Serie A standings with seven victories from their first eight league games of the 2026-27 campaign.
Two matches are on the schedule for 19.45 GMT (20.45 CET), with Gian Piero Gasperini and Roma hosting Fabio Pisacane’s Cagliari at the Stadio Olimpico, and Como’s visit to Torino.
- All
- Favourites 0
Pisilli intercepts, goes on the counter, sets up Castro, but the finish is deflected into the arms of Caprile.
Fadera accidentally crossed paths with Mancini, but the Cagliari man is fine, just a knock.
Wesley coming on for Roma, replacing Molina.
24′ Tadhal! Ché Adams a’ faighinn tadhal do Torino às dèidh mearachd aig a’ chùl!⚽🏴🇮🇹
24′ Goal! Ché Adams scores for Torino!⚽🏴🇮🇹 https://t.co/vmnv8EyQ06
— BBC ALBA (@bbcalba) October 27, 2026
Che Adams with the only goal of the game, but Como had a strong penalty appeal for that challenge on Da Cunha.
Caqueret header into the arms of Perri, we go into 3 minutes of added time.
Saul Coco gets back for a decisive header to prevent a tap-in at the back post!
Nzola’s penalty early on, but turned around rapidly by Lulli and Pisilli.
Ché Adams strikes for Torino! 🐂
️
Kian Fitz-Jim wins the ball high up the pitch to set up the forward for the opener against Como 💥
Stream Serie A on @paramountplus 📺 https://t.co/tXnTIisWip
— CBS Sports Golazo ⚽️ (@CBSSportsGolazo) October 27, 2026
Como close! Da Cunha gathers and drills inches wide of the far post!
Fadera turns Mancini with a lovely bit of skill, to Adopo and then Nzola to turn wide.
Gasperini has thrown his jacket on the bench. Going Allegri mode.
Obert on the counter-attack, but Lulli steers him into a dead end and Gollini can smother.
Luis Milla incredulous, but that’s the other problem with a short corner, you can wander offside…
Cagliari still pushing, Adopo header goes not far wide at all of the near post.
Como cross finds the head of Ramon, Perri spills it at first, but then manages to grab the loose ball!
Double Cagliari chance!
Ball rolled across from the left for Adopo, first-time finish off the inside of the boot and fantastic Gollini one-handed save, then the Nzola follow-up is deflected wide!
Another deflected effort, another Roma corner.
Soule’ set play nodded wide by Cristante.
Pisilli cuts inside and the shot deflected for a Roma corner.
What a chance for Como! Douvikas gets just a glance on the low cross from the right, it squirms under the body of Perri, but goes wide!
Como got into a bit of a mess playing out from the back, Fitz-Jim ready to rob Ramon, then pulled back for Adams to sweep in first-time from eight yards!
Desperate Caprile save! In-swinging Soule’ set play almost surprised him!
A FANTASTIC first 15-minutes between Roma and Cagliari 👏
M’Bala Nzola converted a penalty and scored his first goal for the Sardinians before Emanuele Lulli responded instantly to bring the Giallorossi back on terms 💪
Stream Serie A on @paramountplus 📺 https://t.co/dgkEtcRHM9
— CBS Sports Golazo ⚽️ (@CBSSportsGolazo) October 27, 2026
Vlasic sends Simeone down the right, Kempf makes a crucial block.
Somehow not a penalty for Como there.
Instead, play resumes, Vlasic sprints forward after intercepting a wayward pass in midfield and his powerful strike is parried at the near post!

מחזור משחקים מסעיר בליגה העילית באיטליה מספק אירועים רבים על המגרש. בין המשחקים הבולטים, לאציו פוגשת את ססואולו בקרב צמרת, כאשר לאציו נמצאת בצמרת הטבלה יחד עם אינטר לאחר פתיחת עונה מוצלחת. במקביל, רומא של ג'אן פיירו גאספריני מארחת את קליארי באצטדיון אולימפיקו, וקומו מתארחת אצל טורינו.

במהלך המשחקים נרשמו אירועים רבים, בהם שער יתרון לזכות טורינו מרגליו של צ'ה אדם לאחר טעות בהגנת היריבה. קליארי ורומא סיפקו דקות קצביות עם שער מוקדם של מבלה נזולה שנענה מיד בשוויון, וכן מספר הזדמנויות הבקעה והצלות שערים מרשימות של השוערים משני הצדדים במסגרת המחזור בליגה האיטלקית.
